name: SENIOR
question: How do solifenacin and oxybutynin affect short-term cognitive performance versus placebo in older adults with mild cognitive impairment?

design.population: Twenty-six volunteers aged at least 75 years with mild cognitive impairment were randomized.
design.description: Multicenter, double-blind, three-period crossover randomized trial
design.locator: PubMed abstract, Objective and Design/Intervention; ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01126424, Study Design

verdictNote: No primary composite change was detected; oxybutynin impaired attention in secondary testing.
takeaway: In a placebo-controlled crossover study of older volunteers with mild cognitive impairment, neither solifenacin nor oxybutynin significantly changed five composite cognitive scores from baseline; secondary testing found worse attention with oxybutynin versus placebo at 1–2 hours postdose.

reports.label: Primary cognitive report
reports.citation: Wagg A, Dale M, Tretter R, et al. "Randomised, Multicentre, Placebo-controlled, Double-blind Crossover Study Investigating the Effect of Solifenacin and Oxybutynin in Elderly People with Mild Cognitive Impairment: The SENIOR Study." *Eur Urol.* 2013;64(1):74-81. doi:10.1016/j.eururo.2013.01.002
reports.followUp: Three 21-day treatment periods separated by 21-day washouts

results.measure: Five composite cognitive outcomes at 6 hours after solifenacin and 2 hours after oxybutynin
results.note: Neither active drug had a significant change from baseline in power or continuity of attention, quality of working or episodic memory, or speed of memory.
results.locator: PubMed abstract, Outcome Measurements and Results

results.measure: Power and continuity of attention at 1–2 hours postdose
results.note: Oxybutynin was associated with significant decreases in both measures versus placebo.

harms.label: Dry mouth
harms.note: Mild or moderate dry mouth was the most frequently reported adverse event.

delivery.label: Treatment schedule
delivery.value: Solifenacin 5 mg once daily, oxybutynin 5 mg twice daily, and placebo each for 21 days, with 21-day washouts between periods.
